phase: M1B Phase 1/6 support — safe-plan policy validation
environment: offline fixture tests; executed in GitHub Actions run 40418147090 and locally

checks.description: Additive creates in the reviewed allow-list are allowed (NSGs, rules, alarms, budget, terraform_data)
Gated ingress resources (certificate, listener, backends, DNS, cache rule) are allow-listed for create only
Protected-import update is rejected without allow_import_update
Public 0.0.0.0/0 exposure of 8080/3306 is rejected regardless of allow-list
Unknown (after_unknown) security-rule ingress attributes are rejected
Malformed or truncated plan JSON is rejected before policy evaluation
Plan without resource_changes is rejected (empty plan cannot look safe)

static_guarantees: enable_api_ingress defaults to false and gates every public-ingress resource via count.
Protected imports (VCN, app/lb/mysql subnets, api instances, MySQL DB system, load balancer) are regex-anchored in the policy and matching resources declare prevent_destroy.
The policy rejects any plan whose security-rule change carries unknown source/destination/port attributes, preventing a later reveal of public 8080/3306.
evidence_reference: Job 'CI script and workflow checks' in https://github.com/eswrops/EventForge/actions/runs/40418147090; local run identical (tests/ci/test-safe-plan.sh).
